messages.subject: continues coloring
parts:
I have data for 2 groups (A & B) and currently I am forcing the boxplots to color as follows below.  I have 2 specific questions:

1. What can I do to force one group to be always the same color
2. If I get more than 2 groups lets say 4, how can I make it so that it repeats?

scale_fill_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "pink1"))

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: continues coloring
parts:
What do you mean by "repeat"? You mean so that two and two groups have the same color? Each color in the `values` argument corresponds to (ordered) factor levels in your grouping variable.

Cheers,
Roman
